verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator documents a QR-code transfer that exports codes from an old device, and community users confirm it can export all saved codes into one QR code. That export is described only as a way to re-import into Google Authenticator on another device, and a user reports it is 'stupendously difficult' to get a simple text export, so open-format portability for leaving is unproven. missing for 10: documented open/interoperable export format (e.g. plain otpauth URIs or text/JSON file), documented import path into other authenticator apps, file-based export of all data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: On your old device, create a QR code... On your new device, tap Scan QR code
Google Authenticator has a feature to allow export of all saved codes into one QR code for re-import into Google Authenticator running on another device.
Google Authenticator already has a QR-Code based very easy export procedure
